name: zd-rps
description: Chat-bot middleware: Node/Express + AI backends (LLM, STT, TTS)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w @zd-rps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w @zd-rps/web
